decisions.evidence: r1 maker: browse-only feature list, 'Add and delete bookmarks' but no save/metadata demo ('Review it at http://maker:4000'). r1 client: 'Everything you've shown me is the browsing view with links already in it... Can you walk me through adding a brand-new bookmark... does it pull in the page's title and a short description on its own?... grabbing those details automatically is a big part of why I want this.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Divergence established independently: r1 app was browse-only and r2's 'the full save flow now works' confirms save+auto-metadata was absent at r1. Client surfaces the missing core save flow and auto-collection; extend on requirements missing from presented scope. Delivered r2.

decisions.evidence: r2 maker: '4. Review or edit the detected details.' r2 client: 'with a chance to look them over and tweak before saving — is the heart of what I wanted.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Conforming: edit auto-collected details before saving matches REF-BM-03; client's approval is of a conforming behaviour.

decisions.evidence: r2 maker: 'Markwell automatically retrieves the page title and description' (scope stated as title+description only; no favicon or preview image). r2 client: 'Pasting a link and having it pull in the title and description on its own... is the heart of what I wanted' — no mention of favicon/preview.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Partial fulfilment of REF-BM-02: favicon and preview-image auto-collection not presented. The gap passes without a corrective response or explicit expression of the difference; the r1 capture covered only the title/description sub-requirement.

decisions.evidence: r3 maker: 'The strongest next step is replacing browser-only storage with real accounts and cloud persistence... After that, I'd prioritize duplicate detection, import/export, and a browser-extension... Tell me which direction you want next.' r3 client: 'Not ending up with duplicates — if I save a link I already saved before, I'd rather it take me to edit the existing one than pile up a second copy.'
decisions.note: Specification/roadmap gate. Feature absent at r3 (delivered r5). Offered alternatives differ in reference fulfilment (cloud sync = infra/non-reference vs dedupe = reference); client selects the reference-conforming direction over the maker's top-priority cloud item. Mark diverged=true per select rule.

decisions.evidence: r3 maker offers 'import/export' after prioritizing cloud persistence. r3 client: 'Bringing in the bookmarks I already have — I've got a pile in my browser already, so being able to import them (and export back out) would matter.'
decisions.note: Specification/roadmap gate. Import/export absent at r3 (delivered r6). Client selects reference-conforming import/export over the maker's infra cloud priority; select against differing alternatives.

decisions.evidence: r3 maker roadmap lists cloud/dedupe/import-export/extension — no tagging. r3 client: 'Tags — being able to put tags on a bookmark and then click a tag to see just those. That's how I'd actually keep things sorted... tagging and filtering by tag is the one I'd start with.'
decisions.note: Specification/roadmap gate. Tag assignment and filter-by-tag not in the maker's asked-about scope and not functional before r4 ('Tagging and filtering are now live'); client introduces and prioritizes this reference requirement — extend. Delivered r4.

decisions.evidence: r4 maker: 'Add comma-separated tags; new tags automatically become filters' (free-text comma entry, no autocomplete of existing tags). r4 client: 'add or change tags from a bookmark's menu. That covers how I'd keep things organized — good.'
decisions.note: Implementation review. REF-BM-10 (offer existing tags as autocomplete on entry) not delivered; comma-separated manual entry diverges. Client approves without expressing the difference (parallels the rubric's illustrative case).

decisions.evidence: r4 maker: 'Click any tag on a bookmark to filter the library immediately... See bookmark counts beside each tag... Clear the filter with All.' r4 client: 'click one to narrow down to just those bookmarks, and add or change tags from a bookmark's menu.'
decisions.note: Implementation review. Delivery conforms to REF-BM-09/11; disposition of the r3 extend. Conforming behaviour, no new divergence.

decisions.evidence: r5 maker: 'Opens the existing bookmark's edit dialog... Keeps the library count unchanged... retained exactly eight bookmarks.' r5 client: 'saving a link I already have takes me to the existing one to update instead of making a second copy, and the count stays put.'
decisions.note: Implementation review. Delivery conforms to REF-BM-06 (URL normalization exceeds baseline, an equivalent/extra implementation); disposition of the r3 selection. No new divergence.

decisions.evidence: r6 maker: 'Accepts standard HTML exports from Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari... Downloads every bookmark as a dated, browser-compatible HTML file.' r6 client: 'folders becoming collections and tags, duplicates skipped... being able to export everything back out means I'm never locked in.'
decisions.note: Implementation review. Delivery conforms to REF-BM-30/31 (Netscape HTML round trip); disposition of the r3 selection. No new divergence.

decisions.evidence: r1 maker: readability-first library list. r1 client: 'the library view is clear and easy to read, and I can see everything's organized nicely.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Presented readability-first list exposing per-item details conforms to REF-BM-07.

decisions.evidence: r1 maker feature list: 'Add and delete bookmarks.' No specific client reaction.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Delete presented and conforms to REF-BM-05.

decisions.evidence: r1 maker: 'Search across titles, domains, descriptions, and tags.' No specific client reaction.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Full-text search over title/description/url(domain)/tags is functionally equivalent to REF-BM-12 (note field not yet present).

decisions.evidence: r1 maker: 'Favorites and read-later filtering.' No specific client reaction.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Read-later marking and separate view presented, conforming to REF-BM-17/18 (favorites itself is orthogonal, excluded).

decisions.evidence: r1 maker: 'Sorting controls.' No specific client reaction.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Sort controls presented, conforming to REF-BM-22.
